item.title: 25 Oct 2025 10:30
item.description: TIL certain watches ‘skip seconds’ to conserve battery and to indicate that they are almost out of charge. Noticed this in my Fossil watch a few weeks ago and didn’t bother finding out why. Today, it went dead and only then did I connect the dots! Super neat! Skip a second, warn but still keep time. This is similar to a vehicle’s indicator light flashing quicker when the bulb’s blown. 🔗
